recap.text: Carl sets out the Gangway Chock, a swordsman's breastplate thinned to a fifth of an inch. When he fails, every crawler on the train becomes a flesher, and the first chock he drags crashes off the ceiling. He and Katia push an 800-pound plate against the doorway, and Carl pulls the war mage Dismember's head through a hole in it by the hair. Donut snaps the spell off, and the head drops.

Trapped in a building with Louis and Firas while the camels close in, Carl leans a heavy chock from the subway level against the door and braces it to the ceiling. Louis and Firas hit the deck as an explosive strikes the chock, and fire licks through the room. The chock is peeled open like a baked potato, but the brace holds. The door is shattered, and black smoke fills the room.

Ghommids pound at the temple and Donut's mana is low, so Carl shoves the blessed chock against the door and leans on it. It is a leftover metal door block from the Iron Tangle, coated by Mordecai in holy protection oil, and it should keep the undead from passing through like ghosts. When the gem touches the obelisk and the temple restores itself, the chock disappears, and an intact wooden door stands propped open on a well-lit town.

beats.headline: Holding a car
beats.text: Carl has fabricated quick and dirty fortifications at the engineering workbench: four exterior door blocks and two gangway blocks, enough to hold a cleared car if the doors open on only one side. He closes the door to car three and pulls out a giant rectangle of metal with rounded edges, a swordsman's breastplate thinned to a fifth of an inch so it could be made big. It would take four or five normal humans to lift. He calls it the Gangway Chock, and it is too wide for anything but tiny monsters to slip past. The door blocks are tall wedges made from altered weight benches, held by crossbars through the handholds. He made them too slim, and they rattle.
beats.gist: Carl barricades car three with a rattling Gangway Chock and slim door blocks cut from weight benches.

beats.headline: A head through the plate
beats.text: Fail, and every crawler on the train becomes a flesher, so Carl runs for the back of the train pulling a chock. The first version is too big; it catches on the ceiling and crashes to the floor. The next size down is a flat plate rounded at the top, half an inch thick and around 800 pounds, and Katia helps him push it against the doorway. On the far side the war mage Dismember promises to flay them all. Carl counts to three on his fingers, a hole appears in the metal, and he reaches through and pulls the mage's head through it by the hair. The moment he does, Donut snaps the spell off, and the severed head drops to the floor.
beats.gist: Carl pulls the war mage Dismember's head through a hole in the barricade, and Donut's spell-cancel drops it.

beats.headline: Peeled like a baked potato
beats.text: Trapped in a building with Louis and Firas while the camels close in, Carl leaned one of his heavy chocks from the subway level against the door and braced it to the ceiling. Louis and Firas hit the deck as the chock is hit with an explosive. Fire licks through the room. The chock is bent over and knocked loose with a hole in its centre, peeled open like a baked potato. The brace from floor to ceiling holds. The door itself is shattered, and black, choking smoke fills the room.
beats.gist: Carl braces a chock against the door; an explosive peels it open, but the brace holds.

beats.headline: Blessed, against ghommids
beats.text: Ghommids are pounding at the temple, Donut's mana is low, and Carl pulls the blessed chock: a leftover metal door block from the Iron Tangle that Mordecai coated with a holy protection oil. It is more a repellent than a wall, but it should keep the undead from passing through like ghosts and from pouring into the temple, and it is plenty big enough. He shoves it against the door and leans on it while they pound. When the gem touches the obelisk and the temple restores itself, the metal chock disappears, and in its place stands an intact wooden door, propped open on a well-lit town.
beats.gist: Carl blocks the temple door with a blessed chock, which becomes a wooden door onto a town.

relations.note: He blessed a leftover door block
